## Description

Combines evolutionary population-based training with multi-agent reinforcement learning to evolve robust order allocation and execution schedules across fragmented exchange venues.

## Where it may fit

Large institutional block trades, fragmented liquidity venues (crypto or equities), multi-exchange execution.

## Vehicles

Agency Execution Desks, Algorithmic Execution Brokers, Prop Trading Firms.

## Required data

Level 2/3 order book feeds across multiple venues, historical volume profiles, execution fill logs.

## Caveats

Generational population training requires substantial GPU compute clusters for multi-agent policy convergence.
